purpose: Raw-only opt-in comparison of the frozen Galileo E1 Hatch control with the same safe Hatch contract extended to Galileo E5a.

immutable_references.phase18_status: candidate-no-go; historical artifacts immutable and not retuned

candidate.name: galileo-e1-plus-e5a-safe-hatch
candidate.e5a_threshold_derivation: bandForSignal(GAL_E5A)=L5 and the pinned upstream P pair threshold for L5 is 20 m

candidate_contract.selection_api: Explicit opt-in E1-plus-E5a flag; historical Config.signal and Config.signals behavior remains unchanged
candidate_contract.boundary: abs(I_t) <= the selected signal threshold accepts the Hatch update; abs(I_t) > threshold resets only that satellite/signal arc and emits raw P
candidate_contract.reset_state: current raw P and ADR become the first state of the new arc
candidate_contract.phase16_byte_compatibility: The empty Config.signals E1 call and the Phase16 E1 command remain byte-compatible
candidate_contract.phase17_compatibility: The historical GPS_L1CA+GAL_E1 explicit API remains available and byte-compatible; E5a is enabled only by the new explicit candidate flag

boundary_fixtures: E1 and E5a arcs do not share state
GPS L1 is not selected by the Phase19 candidate

accuracy_protocol.evaluator: existing Phase18 intersection evaluator; control and candidate are read from memory while each route truth file is opened once by one process

pixel7.role: already-used development identity, exact-key comparison only

mi8.role: same-route cross-device development evidence; intersection policy retained from Phase18
mi8.cumulative_truth_read_note: Phase17 and Phase18 already disclosed prior reads; this Phase19 read is an additional single evaluation-recovery read

accuracy_protocol.promotion_gate: Both routes must show candidate strictly better than control in all four variants, with equal-or-better coverage and preserved finite/continuity safety; otherwise No-Go
